use.flag: Minify qrcode.js using uglify-js. Without this flag, the unminified source is installed as qrcode.min.js (functionally identical, slightly larger file). Enable for production deployments.

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Cross-browser QR code generator supporting HTML5 Canvas and table tags. Required by pve-manager: pveproxy serves /qrcode.min.js from /usr/share/javascript/qrcodejs/qrcode.min.js for TOTP enrollment in the pxvirt web UI.
